title: Defences
wikitext:
'''Defences''' is a [[keyword]] that collectively refers to [[armour]], [[evasion]] rating, [[energy shield]],<ref name="Defences" /> and [[ward]]. Armour, Evasion, and Energy Shield are sometimes referred to as the "Primary Defences" as they can be found globally throughout the game via equipment or the passive tree. Ward is a relatively newer type of defence exclusive to items found in the [[Expedition]] mechanic.

Note that {{c|mod|#% increased (Global) Defences}} stats are additive with other mods that globally increase individual Defences, such as {{c|mod|#% increased maximum Energy Shield}}. This means that if you allocate [[Deflection]] for {{c|mod|40% increased Defences from Equipped Shield}} and you have a total of 120% increased maximum Energy Shield from other sources, the total increase is 160% increased maximum Energy Shield; the values are not multiplicative.<ref name="Scaling" />

Although other stats under "Defence" tab of the [[character screen]] may be colloquially referred to as defences (e.g. [[resistance]], [[dodge]], [[block]], [[spell suppression]]), these are not considered Defences for the purpose of the keyword and will not be scaled.

==Items==
===Obtainable===
====Base items====

{{Drop enabled base item table
|tables=items
|where=items.drop_enabled=1 AND items.stat_text LIKE "%defences%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "%Research%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}
{{see also|Armour|Energy Shield|Evasion|Ward}}

====Unique items====
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.drop_enabled=1 AND item_stats.id LIKE "%defences%"
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}

===League reward or legacy items===
{{Item table
|tables=item_stats
|join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID
|where=items.drop_enabled=0 AND item_stats.id LIKE "%defences%" AND items.rarity_id="unique" AND items.is_in_game =1
|large=1
|stat=1
|level=1
}}

== Passive skills ==
[[Passive skills]] for defences include:

{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id = "shield_armour_+%"
  OR passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%defences_+%"
}}

===Masteries===
The following [[Passive Mastery|Masteries]] are related to Defences:
{{Query masteries}}

===Tattoos/Runegrafts===
{{Drop enabled item table
|tables = tattoos
|join = items._pageID = tattoos._pageID
|where = items.class_id="StackableCurrency"
  AND tattoos.target IS NOT NULL
  AND items.description LIKE "%defence%"
|large=1
|description=1
}}

==Related modifiers==
This list does not include modifiers that affect [[energy shield]], [[evasion]] rating and [[armour]] directly.
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mod_stats.id LIKE "%defence%" 
AND mods.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Aggressive Defence%" 
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|generation_type =1
|domain = 1
|tags=1
}}

Note: Fossil exclusive mod (mod in domain "Delve") are mostly disabled to spawn on new item.
===By mod tag===
The following mods has the mod tag "defences" or "jewellery_defense"

====Implicit====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where= (mods.tags HOLDS "defences" OR mods.tags HOLDS "jewellery_defense" ) AND (mods.generation_type = 3 OR mods.generation_type = 5 )
|level=1
|generation_type=1
|spawn_weights=1
|domain=1
}}
====Prefix====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where= (mods.tags HOLDS "defences" OR mods.tags HOLDS "jewellery_defense") AND mods.generation_type = 1
|level=1
|spawn_weights=1
|domain=1
}}
====Suffix====
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where= (mods.tags HOLDS "defences" OR mods.tags HOLDS "jewellery_defense") AND mods.generation_type = 2
|level=1
|spawn_weights=1
|domain=1
}}
